technology_name: LAMP Diagnostic Kit for Sandalwood Spike Disease: Field-Deployable Diagnostic Tool
problem_solved: Existing Sandalwood Spike Disease detection methods are lab-dependent, time-consuming, and unsuitable for rapid, large-scale field screening.
description: Sandalwood Spike Disease (SSD), caused by phytoplasma, is a severe threat to Indian sandalwood, leading to tree death within 1-2 years. Traditional detection methods like PCR are lab-dependent and unsuitable for large-scale screening. This innovation is a field-deployable LAMP-based diagnostic kit that is 100x more sensitive than PCR for rapid SSD detection. It enables early identification in symptomatic and asymptomatic trees, insect vectors, and reservoir hosts, supporting epidemiological mapping and integrated pest management strategies.
applications:
• Rapid, field-level screening of sandalwood trees by forest departments and plantation managers

• Epidemiological mapping and identification of disease transmission agents

• Integration into integrated pest management strategies for commercial sandalwood cultivation

• Early pathogen detection deployment in agricultural diagnostic laboratories
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care
